cases.setup: PRAGMA page_size=512;CREATE TABLE l(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k);CREATE TABLE r(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k);INSERT INTO l VALUES(1,NULL);INSERT INTO l VALUES(2,0);INSERT INTO l VALUES(3,0.0);INSERT INTO l VALUES(4,1);INSERT INTO l VALUES(5,1.0);INSERT INTO l VALUES(6,'1');INSERT INTO l VALUES(7,'01');INSERT INTO l VALUES(8,X'31');INSERT INTO r VALUES(1,NULL);INSERT INTO r VALUES(2,0);INSERT INTO r VALUES(3,0.0);INSERT INTO r VALUES(4,1);INSERT INTO r VALUES(5,1.0);INSERT INTO r VALUES(6,'1');INSERT INTO r VALUES(7,'01');INSERT INTO r VALUES(8,X'31');
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.k,b.k FROM l AS a CROSS JOIN r AS b WHERE a.id<5 ORDER BY a.id DESC,b.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 10;
